intro.headline: Your hosts, keys and history stay on this machine.
intro.body: Sessions, credentials and command history are stored locally and encrypted with a passphrase only you hold. No account, no usage data collection, no cloud service. Create a session, confirm the host key on the first connection, then work in a terminal or the file workbench.
intro.notice: No host names, saved sessions or history are shown.

sessions.title: Session library
sessions.body: Address, authentication, jump hosts and forwards in one saved entry, with groups to keep them apart.

terminal.title: Terminals
terminal.body: A terminal per session with its own font and colour scheme, plus batch commands for several sessions at once.

files.title: File workbench
files.body: Two directories side by side; drag files between them or transfer a whole tree as one archive.

monitor.title: Host monitor
monitor.body: Load, memory, disk and processes are sampled over the existing connection; nothing is installed on the host.

start.title: Getting started
start.stepSession: Create a session: address, authentication, and any jump hosts on the way.
start.stepHostKey: Confirm the host key on the first connection. A key that has changed stops the connection instead of asking twice.
start.stepTerminal: Open a terminal, or the file workbench beside it.
start.pending: Some capabilities are not available yet; they are listed below.
